acceptance: Chart filters and accessible tabular alternatives represent the same source data and unsupported precision is disclosed.

positive.fixture: a chart modelled from labelled marks renders as a named table whose rows are exactly its points with the source's exact text; a filter removes the same points from the table and states how many; hidden series stay listed and marked

negative.fixture: canvas and image charts are unsupported with a reason and the source interface kept; values that cannot be read exactly are refused and numeric filters never keep an unreadable value; more than 100000 marks is unsupported; markup in source text stays text
negative.command: pnpm --filter @vsf/specialized exec node --conditions=source --test --test-reporter=spec --test-name-pattern=never keeps a value|canvas and image|cannot be read exactly|more marks than|narrowly test/chart.test.ts

versions.schema: vsf-chart-v1 model in package; no wire contract yet

security_and_source_permissions: Table cells are built with text content only; no source value is evaluated, converted to floating point or rounded.
performance_memory_storage: Models up to 100000 marks; a chart at the limit builds and filters in the unit test.
known_limitations: Only charts whose marks carry accessible labels are modelled; canvas and image charts are unsupported by design
Axis scales, units conversion and aggregation are not modelled
The alternative table is not yet mapped from a recognized chart in a page
